verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 approval remains supported. The health evaluator's pre-continue-on-error step outcome is exported from the correct identified step, carried through the downstream job, and consumed as a separate fail/recovery condition with distinct marker/title dedupe. Job-level and evaluator-level failures remain independent, mutation return codes are aggregated, missing/skipped outcomes cannot falsely close an alert, and the sparse-checkout plus exact workflow seam assertions cover the live inputs and fail-stop invocation order. I found no blocker, major, or lower-severity diff-scoped issue. Because the prior round was already clean and this round remains clean, progress is stagnant under the prescribed comparison scale.
